# netbox_virtual_circuits (Data Source)

Lists virtual_circuit objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuits" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: cid, cid__empty, cid__ic, cid__ie, cid__iew, cid__iregex, cid__isw, cid__n, cid__nic, cid__nie, cid__niew, cid__nisw, cid__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, provider_account_id, provider_account_id__n, provider_network_id, provider_network_id__n, status, status__empty, status__ic, status__ie, status__iew, status__iregex, status__isw, status__n, status__nic, status__nie, status__niew, status__nisw, status__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_circuits` (Attributes List) The matching virtual_circuits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_circuits))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--virtual_circuits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_circuits`

Read-Only:

- `cid` (String) Circuit ID: unique identifier of the virtual circuit with its provider.
- `circuit_provider_account_id` (Number) Id of the provider account the virtual circuit is billed to.
- `circuit_provider_network_id` (Number) Id of the provider network the virtual circuit is delivered over.
- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, provisioning, active, offline, deprovisioning, decommissioned.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant the virtual circuit belongs to.
- `url` (String)
- `virtual_circuit_type_id` (Number) Id of the virtual circuit type.
